title: The Last Bid
logline: At a lagoon-side fish auction, a buyer who has come every morning for a particular catch loses it, again, to a higher bid.

object.note: Object 2 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: Wanting refused, again: from the full train at the city station to a lagoon-side auction where a regular buyer's catch goes to a higher bid.

thread_out.thread: The catch that went to someone else becomes a net cut by someone else: blocked wanting starts to push back, and the heat of the next stage begins on another shore.

requirements: An active fish auction with a genuine daily market
A regular buyer willing to be followed over more than one morning
Permission to film inside a working market at trading hours

suggestions.name: Negombo fish market
suggestions.why: A well-known daily fish market and auction on the west coast, close to the lagoon and open sea.
suggestions.access_notes: Trading hours are early morning; specific buyers and auctioneers unconfirmed.
suggestions.verify: No buyer, auctioneer or specific market day has been identified.
